data.name: Kaifi
data.gender_notes: Kaifi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'kaff', meaning 'palm of the hand'. It signifies generosity and magnanimity. The name Kaifi carries the meaning “Generous, Magnanimous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaifi usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, magnanimous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Kaifi is mentioned as a name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It also refers to one who is generous and kind-hearted.
data.etymology: Kaifi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Magnanimous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaifi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
